title: Like An Enderman
description: Changes Endermen to look like they do in the "Like An Enderman" AMV
body:
Changes Endermen to look like they do in the "Like An Enderman" AMV, which is a Gangnam Style Minecraft parody by ThnxCya

All it really does is make the Endermen blue

Link to "Like An Enderman": https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0t1QXHT2SmE 

Link to ThnxCya's channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ThnxCya
